literature.finding: Group-mean baseline, then global normalization of the CENTERED advantages; not std of raw rewards.
reinforce_baseline subtracts group mean; later normalizes advantages over all experiences with population variance.
Original DAPO still uses per-group std. Its clip-higher/token aggregation changes do not define centered batch std.
Section 4.1.3 compares group/global mean and std choices; recommendations remain base/data dependent.

interpretation: The group-std amplification hypothesis is not supported: all 6000 saved groups already use a common RAW global reward std, and no active group has reward range below .001.

Source raw std includes between-scene mean differences, while the numerator has already removed those differences. RF++-Baseline centered std removes this denominator component; PPO_FULL gives PG scale multiplier mean1.218, p901.406, max2.935.
This is a PG-to-anchor scale ablation, not improved within-batch ranking or sign assignment. All original hyperparameters, ratios, scope, reference mean anchor beta50 and data are retained.

Global gradient clip1 never activates (largest observed combined gradnorm .05286 across these arms). PPO blocking is sparse and mostly at SDE step9; clip-higher is a lower priority than a measured scale ablation.

Safety-differing groups dominate absolute advantage mass (~89%). Only ~.12% comes from pure-progress groups. Positive unsafe samples with a safe alternative remain possible under scalar PDMS; normalization alone cannot correct that ranking.
Logged anchor/PG scalar loss ratios do not identify their gradient contributions: fresh PPO PG value is zero by centering despite a nonzero PG gradient, and CISPO has a different objective offset.

TRAIN collection rewards vary with sampled scenes and stochastic SDE candidates. TRAIN1024 feedback panels are not generalization proxies; the complete PPO_FULL NAVTEST1k increase and panel decrease must be reported separately.

recommended_one_factor_arm.limitation: No demonstrated gain yet. Global population is only64, not an infinite-batch unbiased guarantee. One of16000 stored PPO_FULL candidates would newly hit the unchanged adv cap5.
